subject: bench: context-injection verdict + report
description:
Read bench/context-inject/results.jsonl and produce a win/loss/inconclusive verdict per arm.

Script: /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/scripts/bench-context-inject-report.js

Metrics per arm vs ARM 0 baseline:
1. Pass rate delta (primary)
2. Weighted cost delta % (full lifecycle)

Win criteria: pass rate >= baseline AND cost delta <= +10%.

Output: table (arm | pass% | cost_delta% | verdict) + recommendation + p-value.
Write to stdout and bench/context-inject/report.md.

No external dependencies beyond Node.js built-ins.
